slug: 2024-08-01 Mauritania pilots digital ID app (e-ID Mauritania)

systems.platform: open-source, mobile-based; components on MTNIMA's GitHub
systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transformation, Innovation and Public Sector Modernization (MTNIMA), with UNDP
systems.tiers: pilot; designed for several identities on one phone and verification without cellular connectivity

systems.owner: National Agency for People Registry and Secure Documents, under the Ministry of Home Affairs

note: UNDP's blog on the digital identity pilot; it places the identity function with the registry agency under the interior ministry but says nothing on registering births or deaths.
